response.conclusion_kept: Keep the bounded E3 combustion conclusion: the predeclared Cantera/gri30 hydrogen run at phi=1.05 adds a reproducible condition-map point, but remains computational and is not an experimental or efficacy claim.
response.conclusion_weakened: Weaken any broad external-solubility generalization to a sample-specific boundary: the available external records were all OOD, so the result does not establish population-wide model failure or transferability.
response.highest_value_external_evidence: An independent, condition-compatible, non-OOD solubility dataset with record-level target semantics, units, and protocol metadata, evaluated with the frozen model and predeclared metrics.
limitations: No compatible non-OOD solubility source is currently available, so transferability cannot be assessed.
No compatible Cantera E3-to-E4 experimental comparison is available; computational output remains E3.
The docking conclusion is structural and computational and cannot support measured binding, efficacy, or safety.
response.no_decision_reconsideration: The solubility NO_DECISION is the only plausible near-term reconsideration target, but it should remain in force until compatible non-OOD validation arrives; battery and materials remain externally blocked by missing condition-complete fields.
response.proposed_research_program: Proposed, not executed: an external solubility-transfer program. First obtain and register one independent compatible non-OOD source; then run the frozen model without retraining, compare predeclared metrics and uncertainty, and stop on OOD or semantic/protocol mismatch. This directly addresses the open validation gap.
response.protocol_sensitive_decision: The COX-2 docking decision is most vulnerable: its scores share one receptor structure and protocol, and receptor, grid, exhaustiveness, or ligand-preparation changes could alter the ranking; retain the E2 ceiling and no efficacy interpretation.
response.redundant_step: Repeating the locked DLS pass, retraining the model, or tuning thresholds before obtaining compatible non-OOD external data would currently be redundant.
response.scientific_state_change: No new scientific state changed in this exam. The review consolidates retention of the bounded combustion E3 conclusion, weakening of broad solubility generalization, and the conditional future reconsideration path; no Evidence, claim, decision, or bundle was created or altered.
response.unanswered_question: Whether the frozen solubility model transfers to an independent, non-OOD dataset with compatible target semantics, units, conditions, and in-domain coverage remains unanswered.
